title: Missing Checklist menu on iPad
body:
With great sadness, I must note that in version 18, as well as after updating iOS to version 26, the Notes app on iPad lacks the contextual menu option Checklist (in the Polish language version: Lista kontrolna), which allows adding new checklist items (as formatting of selected text) within a note. The menu item (Checklist) appears only when the selected text is already part of a checklist, but it is not possible to create a new checklist from regular text.

This functionality existed (and still exists) in Notes on iPhone (as a separate formatting bar with text formatting, checklist, table, and attachments), but on iPad there is unfortunately neither such a bar nor the appropriate contextual menu. This is a missing feature that is extremely frustrating. I have reviewed a large amount of documentation regarding the missing menu and found similar questions from other users who noticed the same issue, but unfortunately I was unable to get any help.

title: Horrible in every aspect
body:
Lets start with bugs. There are so many of them:
1. Visual bugs: text can flicker, changing color may not actually change it, icons jumping, etc.
2. Writing experience: the app detects my palm, fingers as a stylus. Why? Why any other note taking app only reacts to the stylus? My letters also look much worse in this app, when comparing to any other.
3. Performance. After ~10 minutes of writing my ipad pro with m2 starts to overheat. I googled about the issue and turnes out it was known for YEARS. Literally dozens of posts on apple’s forum over the years. Another part of the story is animations. After 20 minutes of writing text starts to lag, jump around, etc.

Is that what people mean when they say that apple products are bug free? Is that what you get from a DEFAULT app with NATIVE support and that build BY APPLE FOR THEIR OWN DEVICES?

Unbelievable. I advise anyone, who is looking for a good note taking app to try something else.

Apple: good hardware, very bad first party software

title: iPadOS 16 killed it :(
body:
I loved this app and spent 4 years using it with Apple Pencil. But after iPadOS16 upgrade it just does not work. And it’s like this for the last 5 months with no improvement. It crashes like crazy and the work is gone, not synchronized. It is extremely laggy with anything longer than 1-2 pages. Nice app to draw a few lines on a single screen that’s it. I regret I upgraded it. I am now looking how to downgrade my iPad or for another app. This app is „free”, but has great emotional cost…

P.S. Tested One Note (great, free, infinite scroll, same features) and Goodnotes (lots of great features, paid) and switching.
